lines.en: label ramen25p2:
After a fair bit of walking, Tsuneyo and I finally make it to the convenience store.
lines.zh: 走了好一阵子，我和 Tsuneyo 终于到了便利店。

lines.en: I try not to think about it often since the place as a whole still makes me feel strange, but the second half of town is surprisingly large.
lines.zh: 我尽量不常去想这件事，因为这地方整体还是让我觉得怪，不过城镇的另一半意外地挺大。

lines.en: Not only that, but it appears to have virtually everything the better half does.
lines.zh: 不仅如此，看起来那边几乎有好的那一半所拥有的一切。

lines.en: Just...worse versions of it.
lines.zh: 只是……都是更差的版本。

lines.en: And as I think that to myself, I realize that Tsuneyo’s outlook on how I should be viewing people isn’t really as bad as it sounded at first.
lines.zh: 而我这样想着，也意识到 Tsuneyo 关于我该如何看待人的那套说法，其实并没有初听起来那么糟。

lines.en: In fact, it’s probably safe to say that virtually everything out there is a better or worse version of something that already exists.
lines.zh: 事实上，大概可以这么说：外面几乎所有东西，都是某个已存在之物的更好或更差的版本。

lines.en: Which calls into question-
lines.zh: 这就引出一个问题——

lines.en: What am I better or worse than?
lines.zh: 我比什么更好，又比什么更差？

lines.en: scene screenplayonion
I guess the answer to that would be everything and nothing.
lines.zh: 我想，答案会是「一切」和「什么都不是」。

lines.en: If I do not know what I am supposed to compare myself to, there is no way I can lose.
lines.zh: 如果我不知道自己该拿什么来比较，那我就根本不可能输。

lines.en: But the fact that I’ve made it this far in this body, which I’m coming to learn may {i}actually{/i} belong to me, sure says something about the competition.
lines.zh: 但我能以这具身体走到今天——而我渐渐发现它也许{i}真的{/i}属于我——这件事本身就足以说明竞争的状况。

lines.en: I think.
lines.zh: 大概吧。

lines.en: For all I know, the reason I’ve made it this far is because I’ve been exponentially worse.
lines.zh: 就我所知，我能走到这一步，也可能是因为我一直都糟糕得多。

lines.en: But I have a suspicion that there aren’t many other versions that, at the very least, Maya has attack-hugged following the end of a wintry beach trip.
lines.zh: 但我怀疑，没有多少个版本，至少能在冬日海滩之旅结束时被 Maya 用「拥抱攻击」扑上来过。

lines.en: So...take that, other Senseis. I guess.
lines.zh: 所以……认输吧，别的 Sensei 们。大概吧。

lines.en: I don’t know. I’m thinking too much again.
lines.zh: 我不知道。我又想太多了。

lines.en: Here is Noriko.
lines.zh: 这位是 Noriko。

lines.en: scene norikotsuneyocon1
: Sensei!
lines.zh: : Sensei！

lines.en: scene norikotsuneyocon2
: Sensei and Tsuneyo!
lines.zh: : Sensei 和 Tsuneyo！

lines.en: : What brings you two in here so late at night?
lines.zh: : 你们俩这么晚来这儿干什么？

lines.en: : Good evening, fellow citizen. I have come in search of onions. Green variety.
lines.zh: : 晚上好，同胞。我来寻找洋葱。绿色的那种。

lines.en: scene norikotsuneyocon3
: Uhh...Tsuneyo? It’s me. Noriko.
lines.zh: : 呃……Tsuneyo？是我啊。Noriko。

lines.en: : I said green, damn it.
lines.zh: : 我说了要绿色的，该死。

lines.en: scene norikotsuneyocon4
: ...Back corner with the rest of the produce stuff.
lines.zh: : ……在后面的角落，跟其他农产品放在一起。

lines.en: : Your assistance has been valuable to me.
lines.zh: : 你的协助对我很有价值。

lines.en: scene norikotsuneyocon5
: Sorry about that. She made a mistake that could send her restaurant spiraling into bankruptcy and leading her into a life of prostitution within the week.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。她犯了个错，可能让她的餐馆在一周内滑向破产，然后过上卖淫的生活。

lines.en: : I don’t really think there’s a big market for prostitution right now.
lines.zh: : 我觉得现在卖淫的市场不大吧。

lines.en: : Why do you know? What have you been doing behind my back?
lines.zh: : 你为什么会知道？你背着我都在干什么？

lines.en: scene norikotsuneyocon6
: Ah! Genuine concern for my well-being!
lines.zh: : 啊！对我的安危是真心的关心！

lines.en: : I have waited years and years for this validation!
lines.zh: : 这份认可我等了好多年好多年了！

lines.en: : Rest assured, Sensei! The only person who gets to lay their hands on this body is you!
lines.zh: : 放心吧，Sensei！唯一能碰这具身体的人就是你！

lines.en: : Or any girl you happen to bring into the mix who you also want to touch my body! That’s okay too!
lines.zh: : 或者你随便带进来的、也想碰我身体的任何女孩！那也行！

lines.en: : I just want to be loved!
lines.zh: : 我只是想被爱！

lines.en: : Violently!
lines.zh: : 狠狠地！

lines.en: : That’s nice, Noriko.
lines.zh: : 真好，Noriko。

lines.en: : I think you’re supposed to comment about why I’m here with Tsuneyo, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我觉得你该问问我为什么和 Tsuneyo 在这儿。

lines.en: scene norikotsuneyocon7
: Why? You already came here with Touka and that was like, fifty times weirder.
lines.zh: : 为什么？你之前还跟 Touka 一起来过呢，那可奇怪五十倍。

lines.en: : Tojo Ramen is right down the road, yeah? I’m smart enough to put two and two together.
lines.zh: : Tojo Ramen 就在路那头，对吧？我还没笨到连这么简单的推理都做不出来。

lines.en: : I mean...it was down {i}several{/i} roads. But it appears that you get the gist.
lines.zh: : 我是说……是隔着{i}好几条{/i}路。不过看来你抓到重点了。

lines.en: scene norikotsuneyocon8
: I require further assistance.
lines.zh: : 我需要进一步的协助。

lines.en: scene norikotsuneyocon9
: Tsuneyo, what’s-
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo，怎么——

lines.en: : These are not onions at all.
lines.zh: : 这些根本不是洋葱。

lines.en: : AHHHHHHHHH!!!!!!!!
lines.zh: : AHHHHHHHHH!!!!!!!!

lines.en: Noriko bursts into hysterical laughter, collapses, cracks her head open on the counter, and dies.
lines.zh: Noriko 爆发出一阵歇斯底里的大笑，然后倒下、头磕在柜台上裂开，死了。

lines.en: Tojo Ramen goes out of business and Tsuneyo spends the rest of her life working at the convenience store instead.
lines.zh: Tojo Ramen 倒闭，Tsuneyo 余生在便利店打工。

lines.en: scene sky
And me?
lines.zh: 而我呢？

lines.en: Well...
Let’s just say I found my own place in life.
lines.zh: 这么说吧，我找到了自己的人生位置。

lines.en: I retired from teaching and started a nonprofit organization meant to help [teenage]girls in need.
lines.zh: 我从教职退休，创办了一个旨在帮助有需要的[teenage]女孩的非营利组织。

lines.en: Seven years later, I was elected the new prime minister of Japan after the borders opened back up.
lines.zh: 七年后，边境重新开放，我当选为日本的新任首相。

lines.en: But I still think back on those days I spent at [kumon_mi_high] sometimes.
lines.zh: 但我有时还是会想起在 [kumon_mi_high] 度过的那些日子。

lines.en: And, if I listen closely-
lines.zh: 而且，如果我仔细听——

lines.en: I can still hear the echoes of laughter that would ring out in the halls of the dorm.
lines.zh: 我依然能听见宿舍走廊里回荡的笑声。

lines.en: Oh, what wonderful times those were.
lines.zh: 啊，那是多么美好的时光啊。

lines.en: : Tsuneyo...you should probably put those back.
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo……你大概该把那些放回去。

lines.en: scene norikotsuneyocon10
: Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : Well...for one, they aren’t onions. And that’s what you came here for. Remember?
lines.zh: : 嗯……首先，它们不是洋葱。而你就是来买洋葱的。记得吗？

lines.en: : I do not intend to purchase these. I am just curious about their purpose.
lines.zh: : 我没打算买这些。我只是好奇它们的用途。

lines.en: : They are vegetable covers.
lines.zh: : 那是蔬菜套。

lines.en: scene norikotsuneyocon11
: Vegetable covers?
lines.zh: : 蔬菜套？

lines.en: : Yeah. You place them around longer vegetables or fruits like bananas or cucumbers and it keeps them fresh longer.
lines.zh: : 对。你把它们套在长一点的蔬菜或水果上，比如香蕉或黄瓜，能保鲜更久。

lines.en: : They even have a coating on the outside that keeps germs away.
lines.zh: : 它们外面还有一层涂层，能隔绝细菌。

lines.en: : Will they fit around a green onion?
lines.zh: : 它们套在青葱上也合适吗？

lines.en: : Sure. Why not?
lines.zh: : 当然。为什么不呢？

lines.en: : Then perhaps I will buy some for the walk home. Tonight is a good night.
lines.zh: : 那我也许买几个路上用。今晚是个好日子。

lines.en: scene black
Noriko snatches the condoms away from Tsuneyo and explains to her what they actually are, which disappoints me because I was curious if they really would fit a green onion or not.
lines.zh: Noriko 一把把避孕套从 Tsuneyo 手里抢走，向她解释这东西到底是什么，这让我有点失望，因为我本来还好奇它们到底能不能套住一根青葱。

lines.en: And, of course, Tsuneyo reacted like this once she realized I lied to her...
lines.zh: 当然，Tsuneyo 发现我骗她之后，反应是这样的……

lines.en: scene norikotsuneyocon12
: You have deceived me yet again. You are truly a man to be feared.
lines.zh: : 你又一次欺骗了我。你真是个该畏惧的男人。

lines.en: : I didn’t deceive you. I was just setting you up for the opportunity to be lectured on safe sex and other forms of contraceptives.
lines.zh: : 我没骗你。我只是给你制造了一个机会，好让你接受安全性行为和其他避孕方式的教育。

lines.en: : Next week, we’re going to talk about birth control!
lines.zh: : 下周我们要讲避孕！

lines.en: : This man will be dead next week. And so will I if I do not return to the restaurant.
lines.zh: : 这个男人下周就死了。而如果我不回餐馆，我也活不成。

lines.en: : I didn’t realize it was a matter of life and death now.
lines.zh: : 我不知道这事现在成了生死攸关的大事。

lines.en: : Everything is a matter of life and death. Green onions...contraceptives...even the ground we walk on.
lines.zh: : 万事都是生死攸关。青葱……避孕套……甚至我们脚下的土地。

lines.en: scene norikotsuneyocon13
: But life is stronger than death! So life will win!
lines.zh: : 但生命比死亡更强！所以生命会赢！

lines.en: : And the ground will remain the ground!
lines.zh: : 而土地依然是土地！

lines.en: : Flavor will prevail!
lines.zh: : 风味必胜！

lines.en: : Yaaaaaay~
scene norikotsuneyocon14
: I am ready to return home now.
lines.zh: : 我准备好回家了。

lines.en: : I feel as if my impromptu speech did not leave the impression I was hoping it would.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我刚才那番即兴演讲，没留下我期望的印象。

lines.en: : I really don’t even understand what the point you were trying to get across was.
lines.zh: : 我甚至完全没搞懂你想表达的重点是什么。

lines.en: : Something about the connection between food and the desire to survive and grow.
lines.zh: : 大概是食物与生存、成长的欲望之间的联系。

lines.en: : Yeah, I can’t really say that came across at all.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我只能说完全没传达出来。

lines.en: : I will continue improving my speech when I am not busy destroying my father’s legacy.
lines.zh: : 我会在不忙着毁掉父亲遗产的时候，继续改进我的演讲。

lines.en: : For now, it is best that we return to Tojo Ramen, where noodles reign supreme and hearts are 50%% off the third Sunday of every month.
lines.zh: : 现在，我们最好回 Tojo Ramen——那里面条至上，每月第三个星期天心脏一律五折。

lines.en: : I love chicken hearts. When I was little, I used to bite into them and pretend that I was eating the heart of a baby.
lines.zh: : 我爱鸡心。我小时候总咬着它们，假装在吃婴儿的心脏。

lines.en: scene norikotsuneyocon15
: Those things are not as close in size as you believe them to be, but I still invite you to dine at Tojo Ramen on the third Sunday of every month for 50%% off of strange childhood memories.
lines.zh: : 那两样东西的尺寸可没你想的那么接近，但我还是邀请你在每月第三个星期天来 Tojo Ramen 用餐，奇特的童年回忆五折优惠。

lines.en: : Better idea! How about I come along now?
lines.zh: : 更好的主意！我现在就跟你们去怎么样？

lines.en: : Now?
lines.zh: : 现在？

lines.en: : Yeah! Nobody’s come in all night, so I’m pretty sure I can close without getting in trouble.
lines.zh: : 对！一整晚都没人来，所以我肯定能关门而不惹麻烦。

lines.en: scene norikotsuneyocon16
: Business has been slow here as well?
lines.zh: : 这里的生意也很冷清吗？

lines.en: : Not {i}slow{/i}. Non-existent. No clue what’s going on, but it’s been super boring.
lines.zh: : 不是「{i}冷清{/i}」。是压根没有。不知道怎么回事，就是无聊得要命。

lines.en: : I’d much rather hang out with you two.
lines.zh: : 我更想跟你们俩待在一起。

lines.en: : You’re sure it’s okay to leave?
lines.zh: : 你确定可以离开？

lines.en: scene norikotsuneyocon17
: Nope! But it’s not like I really need this job anyway. I just wanted some extra money to buy more nice underwear and stuff.
lines.zh: : 不确定！不过反正我也不怎么需要这份工作。我只是想多赚点钱，买更好的内衣什么的。

lines.en: : Especially since I have an official history of giving pairs to you now.
lines.zh: : 尤其是现在我已经有给你送内裤的官方记录了。

lines.en: : Oh, right. That’s a thing you did.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。你确实干过这事。

lines.en: : You wear women’s underwear? That is disgusting.
lines.zh: : 你穿女人内裤？真恶心。

lines.en: : I don’t-
lines.zh: : 我没有——

lines.en: : Never talk to me or my son again, pervert.
lines.zh: : 别再跟我或我儿子说话了，变态。

lines.en: : Yaaaay! Field trip!
lines.zh: : 耶！课外教学活动！

lines.en: scene black
So...it appears that the time has come for me to head back to Tojo Ramen with Tsuneyo {i}and{/i} Noriko.
lines.zh: 所以……看来是时候和 Tsuneyo {i}还有{/i} Noriko 一起回 Tojo Ramen 了。

lines.en: It’s not really how I expected the night to go, but at least Tsuneyo got what she came for.
lines.zh: 这不是我预想中今晚的走向，但至少 Tsuneyo 拿到了她要的东西。

lines.en: scene norikotsuneyocon18
Or...at least that’s what I would say if she didn’t only buy two bundles of them.
lines.zh: 或者……如果她不是只买了两把的话，我本来会这么说的。

lines.en: : Are you sure that’s going to be enough?
lines.zh: : 你确定这些够用吗？

lines.en: : No. But it is the first time I am acting against the wishes of the Produce Delivery Administration and I don’t want to step too far out of line.
lines.zh: : 不确定。但这是我第一次违逆农产品配送管理局的意愿，我不想做得太过火。

lines.en: : I hate those guys.
lines.zh: : 我讨厌那帮人。

lines.en: : Wait, they’re a real thing? I thought that was just Tsuneyo being Tsuneyo again.
lines.zh: : 等等，他们是真的存在的？我以为那又是 Tsuneyo 的 Tsuneyo 行为。

lines.en: : I am always Tsuneyo, you bastard. How dare you question the legitimacy of my existence.
lines.zh: : 我永远都是 Tsuneyo，你这混蛋。你竟敢质疑我存在的正当性。

lines.en: : Tsuneyo-
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo——

lines.en: scene norikotsuneyocon19
: Get leeked, bro.
lines.zh: : 吃我一葱，兄弟。
: ……为什么？

lines.en: : You know, Tsuneyo, we haven’t really talked about it before...but I’m kind of a rival of yours in a way.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗 Tsuneyo，我们之前其实没聊过……但我在某种意义上算是你的对手。

lines.en: scene norikotsuneyocon20
: If this is about me becoming a romantic candidate for our teacher, you do not need to consider me a rival.
lines.zh: : 如果是指我成了我们老师的恋爱候选之一，你不必把我看成对手。

lines.en: : That is something I am not interested in now...and likely never will be.
lines.zh: : 那是我现在不感兴趣的……而且大概永远也不会感兴趣的。

lines.en: : Thanks.
lines.zh: : 谢谢。

lines.en: : Not about that. About the whole restaurant thing.
lines.zh: : 不是那个。是关于开餐馆的事。

lines.en: : It’s not really {i}near{/i} here, but my family actually owns and operates a Chinese restaurant that does decently well, if I’m remembering correctly.
lines.zh: : 虽然离这儿不算{i}近{/i}，但我家其实经营着一家中餐馆，如果我没记错的话，生意还不错。

lines.en: : So we both come from families who work in food service and stuff.
lines.zh: : 所以我们俩都来自做餐饮的家庭什么的。

lines.en: : Are you challenging me?
lines.zh: : 你在向我发起挑战吗？

lines.en: : Not really. I’m just-
lines.zh: : 不算。我只是——

lines.en: scene norikotsuneyocon21
: Get leeked.
lines.zh: : 吃我一葱。
: ……为什么？

lines.en: : I don’t like this new habit of yours.
lines.zh: : 我不喜欢你这个新习惯。

lines.en: : I do not like being challenged by the same person who sold me the produce I am going to serve to customers.
lines.zh: : 我不喜欢被那个把我要端给客人的农产品卖给我的人挑战。

lines.en: : For all I know, she poisoned these ingredients to put my family’s restaurant out of business.
lines.zh: : 搞不好她在食材里下了毒，就为了让我家的餐馆倒闭。

lines.en: : I know your games, Pink Psion of...Pinkness!
lines.zh: : 你的把戏我清楚得很，粉色的……粉色灵能者！

lines.en: : I can’t remember your name!
lines.zh: : 我想不起你的名字！

lines.en: : It’s actually just...Noriko...
lines.zh: : 其实就叫……Noriko……

lines.en: scene norikotsuneyocon22
: Besides, I’m not trying to challenge you. I’m just trying to draw similarities and stuff.
lines.zh: : 再说，我不是在挑战你。我只是想找点共同点什么的。

lines.en: scene norikotsuneyocon23
: You’re one of the few girls in the class that I’m not really close with yet. So I thought it might be easier to get to know you if you realize we have something in common.
lines.zh: : 你是班上我为数不多还不太熟的女孩之一。所以我想，如果你发现我们有共同点，也许会更容易亲近些。

lines.en: : I understand now and apologize for leeking you.
lines.zh: : 我明白了，并为用葱打你道歉。

lines.en: : It’s whatever. It happens.
lines.zh: : 无所谓。常有的事。

lines.en: : Does it?
lines.zh: : 是吗？

lines.en: : Your family’s restaurant...do they make their own noodles?
lines.zh: : 你家的餐馆……他们自己做面条吗？

lines.en: : I...think so?
lines.zh: : 我……应该是吧？

lines.en: scene norikotsuneyocon24
: Excellent. This is all I needed to hear.
lines.zh: : 很好。我只需要听到这些就够了。

lines.en: : Any restaurant who takes the time to create such a thing can not be called a rival of mine.
lines.zh: : 任何肯花心思去做这种事的餐馆，都不能称为我的对手。

lines.en: : The true goal after all is spreading joy throughout the world in the form of thin wheat or rice tubes for people to swallow.
lines.zh: : 毕竟真正的目标，是以供人吞咽的细小麦管或米管的形式，把喜悦传播到全世界。

lines.en: : As long as this mission is being accomplished, it does not matter who profits in the end.
lines.zh: : 只要这个使命在被完成，最后谁赚钱都不重要。

lines.en: scene norikotsuneyocon25
: My father started Tojo Ramen with one goal in mind...to make people smile.
lines.zh: : 我父亲创办 Tojo Ramen 只有一个目标……让人们微笑。

lines.en: : As such...I, too, want to make people smile.
lines.zh: : 因此……我也想让人们微笑。

lines.en: : A good place to start would be not slapping them with vegetables.
lines.zh: : 一个好的开始是别拿蔬菜扇他们。

lines.en: scene norikotsuneyocon26
: Smile. I command it.
lines.zh: : 微笑。我命令你。

lines.en: : Were you not listening to what I just said or do you actually just hate me?
lines.zh: : 你是没听见我刚才说的话，还是真的就那么恨我？

lines.en: : Tsuneyo, don’t leek Sensei. He’s physically incapable of smiling. It’s not fair.
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo，别用葱打 Sensei。他生理上没法笑。这不公平。

lines.en: : Noriko is right. I don’t think my facial muscles work that way.
lines.zh: : Noriko 说得对。我觉得我的面部肌肉不是那么运作的。

lines.en: : Also, if I knew this journey was going to be for the purpose of buying you weapons, I would not have come.
lines.zh: : 再说，如果我知道这趟旅程的目的是给你买武器，我就不会来了。

lines.en: : Anything is a weapon if you try hard enough.
lines.zh: : 只要够努力，任何东西都能当武器。

lines.en: : Tsuneyo’s right. If the world were to end tomorrow and zombies started popping up or something, you’d use anything you can get your hands on as a weapon.
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo 说得对。如果明天世界末日、僵尸冒出来什么的，你会把手边任何东西当武器用。

lines.en: : Even a leek?
lines.zh: : 连葱也行？

lines.en: : Hey, it’s working for her.
lines.zh: : 嘿，对她挺管用的。

lines.en: : Also, what if leeks {i}are{/i} the weakness of zombies and just...nobody’s figured it out yet because no one in their right mind would use one?
lines.zh: : 再说了，万一葱{i}就是{/i}僵尸的弱点，只是……没人发现，因为脑子正常的人不会拿葱当武器呢？

lines.en: : We could be onto something here.
lines.zh: : 我们可能发现了什么了不起的东西。

lines.en: : Listen to the Psion, bro. Accept the leek as punishment for your various misdeeds.
lines.zh: : 听灵能者的话，兄弟。接受这根葱，作为你各种恶行的惩罚。

lines.en: : Sigh.
lines.zh: : 叹气。

lines.en: : ...Did you just {i}say{/i} “sigh?...”
lines.zh: : ……你刚刚是「{i}说{/i}」出了「叹气」吗？……

lines.en: scene black
The three of us move through the streets on the way back to Tojo Ramen and, despite the great amount of glares we received on the way {i}to{/i} the convenience store, nothing happens on the way back.
lines.zh: 我们三个穿过街道回 Tojo Ramen，尽管{i}去{/i}便利店的路上收到了不少白眼，回来的路上倒什么也没发生。

lines.en: And I doubt it’s because Noriko makes us somehow look {i}less{/i} suspicious, so I just chalk it up to it being past all of the old, homeless peoples’ bedtimes or something.
lines.zh: 我怀疑这不是因为 Noriko 让我们看起来{i}没那么{/i}可疑，所以我只能把这归功于——那些无家可归的老头老太太们都过了睡觉时间什么的。

lines.en: Either way, we make it back to the ramen shop, leeks in tow, and prepare to head inside.
lines.zh: 总之，我们带着葱回到了拉面店，准备进去。

lines.en: scene norikotsuneyocon27
: Thanks for letting us come over so late, Tsuneyo. I’m sure you’re normally closing up by now.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你让我们这么晚还过来，Tsuneyo。你平时这个点应该已经打烊了吧。

lines.en: : I’m sorry?
lines.zh: : 你说什么？

lines.en: : ...Am I misunderstanding what’s happening right now?
lines.zh: : ……我是不是误会了现在的情况？

lines.en: scene norikotsuneyocon28
: Tojo Ramen is already closed for the night.
lines.zh: : Tojo Ramen 今晚已经打烊了。

lines.en: : Please do not tell Yelp.
lines.zh: : 请不要告诉 Yelp。

lines.en: : Then...why did you let us just walk you all the way back without saying anything?
lines.zh: : 那……你为什么一路上什么都不说，就这么让我们陪你走回来？

lines.en: : I said many things. The most popular of which was, “Get leeked, bro.”
lines.zh: : 我说了很多话。其中说得最多的是，「吃我一葱，兄弟。」

lines.en: : You did say that several times.
lines.zh: : 这句你确实说了好几次。

lines.en: : Can we at least get like...a drink of water or something?
lines.zh: : 我们至少能……喝口水什么的吧？

lines.en: : I apologize, but water is for paying customers only.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，水只供应给付费顾客。

lines.en: : Please return tomorrow when we are open and have replenished our stock of green onions.
lines.zh: : 请明天我们开门、且补货完青葱之后再来。

lines.en: : But the...stock is replenished now...
lines.zh: : 可是……货现在就补好了啊……

lines.en: scene norikotsuneyocon29
: Thank you for helping me conquer the Produce Delivery Administration and restore my father’s legacy.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你们帮我战胜农产品配送管理局，恢复我父亲的遗产。

lines.en: : I am sure that everyone will forgive my transgressions and return to purchasing noodles from me right away.
lines.zh: : 我相信所有人都会原谅我的过失，并立刻回来买我的面。

lines.en: : Except for right now, you mean. Because...you won’t let us buy any.
lines.zh: : 除了现在，你是说。因为……你不让我们买。

lines.en: : Read the sign, bro.
lines.zh: : 看牌子，兄弟。

lines.en: : But...the sign just says “ramen.”
lines.zh: : 可是……牌子上只写了「拉面」。

lines.en: scene norikotsuneyocon30
: Oh.
: I suppose it does.
lines.zh: : 好像是这么回事。

lines.en: : Goodnight.
lines.zh: : 晚安。

lines.en: scene norikotsuneyocon31
Tsuneyo goes back into Tojo Ramen, leaving Noriko and me alone in the cold...
lines.zh: Tsuneyo 回到 Tojo Ramen 里，把我和 Noriko 留在寒冷中……

lines.en: : Sigh.
: Sigh, indeed.
lines.zh: : 确实是，唉。

lines.en: scene black
The two of us wind up taking a bus back to the area surrounding the dorms and grab something to eat over there.
lines.zh: 我们俩最后坐公交回了宿舍区，在那边随便吃了点东西。

lines.en: I walk Noriko back to her room once we’re done and the two of us part with a hug that I did not anticipate or even really want in the first place.
lines.zh: 吃完后我送 Noriko 回房间，分别时她抱了我一下——那是我没预料到、其实也不太想要的。

lines.en: But hey, things like that are bound to happen when someone is in love with you.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，有人爱着你的时候，这种事总会发生。

lines.en: And it’s not like hugs are unenjoyable or anything.
lines.zh: 而且拥抱也不是不享受什么的。

lines.en: They’re just...
lines.zh: 它们只是……

lines.en: Weird.
lines.zh: 很怪。

lines.en: I walk the rest of the way home thinking about how strange the concept of hugging is and how I would have much preferred a parting blowjob instead.
lines.zh: 剩下的回家路上，我一直在想「拥抱」这个概念有多奇怪，以及我更想要的其实是分别时的一个口活。
